# Lyricron

> Create perfectly timed lyrics by ear: play a track, tap along, and export a ready-to-use .lrc file. Free, 100% private, and works entirely offline in the browser.

## The app

- [Launch the app](__SITE_URL__/app/): the Lyricron editor, no account or install needed.

## Pages

- [Home](__SITE_URL__/): what Lyricron is and why you'd use it.
- [How it works](__SITE_URL__/how-it-works/): the step-by-step guide to syncing lyrics to a song.
- [LRC format](__SITE_URL__/lrc-format/): what an .lrc file is, its syntax and tags, and LRC vs SRT.
- [FAQ](__SITE_URL__/faq/): short answers to the most common questions.
- [Privacy](__SITE_URL__/privacy/): Lyricron never uploads your files; everything runs in the browser.
- [Blog](__SITE_URL__/blog/): guides on the LRC format, syncing lyrics, and player setup.
